# Documentation and HUD copy update

## Summary

Bring all player- and developer-facing documentation in line with the visible
collector-drone behaviour and the retired instant score burst.

## Target outcome

Research notes, GDD, README and HUD copy describe the drone, its upgrades and
its destruction rule; help text no longer promises an instant bounty.

## Minimal implementation

- Update `docs/CLASSIC_POWERUP_WEAPON_RESEARCH.md` §8 to describe the
  visible-drone adaptation and the retired score burst.
- Update the GDD power-up catalogue (`docs/Game Design Document.md` §4.4) with
  the drone's behaviour, level axes and destruction rule.
- Update `README.md` and any relevant help/HUD copy (`src/ui/HUD.ts`) so the
  drone row reflects level-driven state with no timed-window language.
- Refresh code comments in the touched core/entity/effects files.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including
  code comments, `docs/CLASSIC_POWERUP_WEAPON_RESEARCH.md` §8, the GDD
  power-up catalogue, `README.md` and any relevant help/HUD copy.
- The documents describe the visible collector-drone adaptation and the
  retired score burst; no stale timed-window or `mysteryUfoScore` language
  remains in help/HUD copy.
- Documentation references the parent item AH-0MV9G113S009B37I.

## Parent AC covered

Covers parent AC7 (all related documentation updated: code comments, research
§8, GDD catalogue, README, help/HUD copy).

# Parity hardening and full-suite verification

## Summary

Final verification gate: confirm the gym↔game parity guards
(`CombatScene.equivalence.test.ts`, `gymParityDocs.test.ts`) still hold after
the drone work, that no duplicate drone implementation exists anywhere, and
that the full project test suite passes.

## Target outcome

The parent's AC8 (full suite green) and AC6 (equivalence + docs assertion
hold) are verified before the item reaches `in_review`.

## Minimal implementation

- Run the full project test suite via the test skill and triage any failures
  into critical `test-failure` work items (following the triage policy).
- Verify `CombatScene.equivalence.test.ts` and `gymParityDocs.test.ts` pass
  and that no per-scene divergent drone copy exists (grep for drone logic,
  duplicate-body guard).
- Confirm the retired instant-bounty symbols are grep-clean across `src/`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The full project test suite must pass with the new changes — no new
  failures attributable to the drone work.
- `CombatScene.equivalence.test.ts` and `gymParityDocs.test.ts` are green and
  unchanged in intent.
- No duplicate drone implementation exists outside the shared core; the
  retired `consumeMysteryBonus`/`_mysteryBonus`/`mysteryUfoScore` symbols are
  absent from `src/`.

## Parent AC covered

Covers parent AC8 (full project test suite passes) and the parity assertion
of AC6.
data.title: Parity hardening and full-suite verification

# Documentation and audit-contract alignment

**Goal:** Make the new harness contract, project split, test-type registration
and timing expectations discoverable and correct in every affected doc/comment,
and prove the audit gate still accepts the full suite (parent AC8, AC6).

**Deliverables**

- `src/test/gameHarness.ts` header rewritten for deterministic-by-default boot
  (legacy real-time path documented as removed).
- `vitest.config.ts` comments describing the `unit`/`integration` split, the
  Phaser classification rule, and the measured pool/isolate choices.
- `README.md` § Testing conventions updated: deterministic boot is the default
  (no opt-in flag), how to run the fast loop (`/skill:test --type unit`,
  `npx vitest run --project unit`), and the timing expectations.
- The deterministic-boot convention documentation produced under
  AH-0MUJK70PU003VLIB updated (or superseded with a pointer) so it no longer
  describes `deterministicBoot` as an opt-in.
- Any `docs/` page describing how to run tests (`docs/dev/` test references)
  updated; `.pi/skills_extensions/test/extension.json` documented as the
  project test-type registration point.
- `CHANGELOG.md` deliberately untouched (managed by the ship release pipeline).
- A verification note showing `implement.py finish` / the audit F3 cache lookup
  still finds a full-suite evidence entry after the config change.

**Key Files:**

- `src/test/gameHarness.ts`, `vitest.config.ts`, `README.md`
- `docs/dev/gameplay-capture.md` and sibling `docs/dev/` pages that reference test execution
- `.pi/skills_extensions/test/extension.json` (documentation reference only)

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1:** No document or code comment still describes real-time/`setTimeout`
  boot as the default, or `deterministicBoot` as an opt-in flag that must be
  passed.
- **AC2:** `README.md` and every affected `docs/` page document the
  `unit`/`integration` split, the sanctioned run commands (`/skill:test --type
  unit`, `/skill:test --type full`, `npm --silent test`) and the current timing
  expectations with the load conditions under which they were measured.
- **AC3:** `CHANGELOG.md` is unchanged by this work.
- **AC4:** Documentation updated — every affected doc/comment reflects the new
  harness contract, project split and timing expectations, at minimum the
  `src/test/gameHarness.ts` header, the `vitest.config.ts` comments, the
  deterministic-boot convention doc from AH-0MUJK70PU003VLIB, the `README.md`
  test instructions, and any `docs/` page describing how to run tests;
  `CHANGELOG.md` remains out of scope (ship release pipeline owns it).
- **AC5:** The audit contract is demonstrated intact: a green full-suite cache
  entry exists (`scope: full`, `test_type: full`, `exit_code: 0`) and the
  `implement.py finish` / audit F3 lookup path resolves it after the config
  change (evidence linked on this item).

**Dependencies:** after the harness default (C2), project split (C3) and the
timing work (C4, C5, C6, C7) so the documented numbers match reality.

**References:** Parent AH-0MVF3BESP005ZDAV § AC6, AC8; AH-0MUJK70PU003VLIB (the
opt-in documentation this item inverts); test skill § 1a.
data.title: Documentation and audit-contract alignment
